chunks: So taste [the punishment] for your forgetting the meeting of your Day, indeed We have forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'We have forgotten you' in Surah As-Sajdah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the principle of *al-Jaza' min Janis al-'Amal* (recompense akin to the deed), where the disbelievers' self-imposed neglect of the Hereafter becomes the very mechanism of their eternal punishment. The phrase 'We have forgotten you' is interpreted not as divine ignorance but as a withdrawal of mercy, rendering them to the consequences of their own choices. This reciprocal justice underscores the reality of *Barzakh* and the finality of the Day of Judgment for those who ignored the call to remembrance.
